name: Russian Roulette
aliases: Russian Roulette for Ray Marching Termination
definition: A technique to probabilistically terminate paths with low contribution weight to reduce computation, scaling up weight if path continues to maintain unbiased expectation.
summary: Russian Roulette is a randomized early-out technique that probabilistically terminates low-contribution rays while scaling weights to maintain unbiased volume rendering results, unlike deterministic cutoffs that introduce bias.
